name: Wearing Mixed Linens
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers to avoid wearing garments made of mixed fabrics, specifically linen and wool, as stated in Leviticus 19:19 and Deuteronomy 22:11. This command reflects God's desire for holiness and separation, emphasizing obedience to His statutes. Additionally, Deuteronomy 22:5 highlights the importance of maintaining distinctiveness in dress according to gender, reinforcing the principle that crossing these boundaries is considered an abomination to the Lord.
